title: David Chicken
body:
Description

David Chicken, the beacon of hope and manager of the Finlay Island lighthouse, is the go-to guy for all your Oaklands gifting needs. Whether you're looking for lanterns to light up the night, vehicles to traverse the island, or the perfect property spawn location, his shop is open 24/7 and always fully stocked. Just don't ask him to climb to the top of the lighthouse to change a bulb, or he'll make you do it instead.

Trivia

  • His name might be a reference to the popular adult stop-motion series, Robot Chicken.
